top_signals.title: Inside the New War for Critical Metals
top_signals.summary: Legendary mining investor Robert Friedland joins Bloomberg Open Interest to explains why copper and rare earth metals have become the new front line in a US, China resource cold war. He breaks down how China quietly seized control of critical supply chains, why AI data centers are sending metal demand into overdrive and what it all means for national security, energy transition, and the future of the global economy. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
